    "Project A: One-Sentence Summary - A mobile app that lets shoppers scan product barcodes to see an animal-welfare "grade," then discover more humane and plant-based alternatives available in-store, nearby, or for delivery. 

**Pros:**
•   **Clarity of Value Proposition:** Relatively clear – simplifies ethical consumerism by providing a quick assessment and alternative suggestions.
•   **Market Size & Demand:** Addresses a growing market segment concerned with animal welfare and sustainability. The broad scope (groceries, cosmetics, etc.) suggests significant potential.
•   **Feasibility & Development Plan:** Prototype exists with a substantial database and user base, demonstrating some initial traction. Roadmap outlines a logical progression of features.
•   **Revenue Model & Sustainability:**  Reliance on user-generated data (receipts, surveys) and potential partnerships offers a plausible, though potentially slow, path to revenue.
•   **Differentiation:** The barcode scanning and alternative discovery feature is a novel approach compared to simply listing ethical brands.
•   **Impact & Evidence Plan:** Cites external reporting and shopper survey statistics to support the problem statement.  The philanthropic funding adds credibility.
•   **Risk Awareness & Mitigation:** Acknowledges the challenge of consumer awareness and the dependence on retailer behavior.

**Cons:**
•   **Reliance on Third-Party Standards:** The grading system's validity hinges on the accuracy and perceived credibility of the underlying certification programs.
•   **Marketing Dependency:** Significant marketing investment will be needed to achieve scale.
•   **Data Quality:**  User-generated data (receipts, surveys) can be noisy and require significant cleaning and validation.

**Pros:**

•   **Market Size & Demand:** Addresses a widespread and potentially stressful situation for drivers.
